reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first query helper and the LinkAccountBaseParams upgradingId convention; no existing duplicate-link check existed to reuse, though link.ts (which already holds findOrCreateBank) would have been a natural home.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere; only a three-line call is repeated in each of the five already-parallel provider link functions.

placement.why: Server-side guard in the accounts app module next to the link handlers is reasonable, though the link-specific DB helper module link.ts would arguably fit better.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and focused tests; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Clear single helper with explicit provider/id/upgradingId inputs; the remaining risk is that a future sixth provider must remember to call it, as with the other per-provider copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link handlers go through the new shared guard; no existing abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: The linked-elsewhere query exists once; call sites only pass their provider literal and account id.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
